objective: Measure the dev NUC and define service-specific resource guardrails that preserve host responsiveness under supported development profiles.

authority.decision_owner: Unison infrastructure maintainers and the NUC owner
external_actions: collect inventory and load measurements on the dev NUC

allowed_changes: service-specific memory, swap, CPU, restart, health, and degradation budgets
non_goals: merging the old uniform resource overlay

handoff.current_state: The retired workspace overlay is preserved as design input only; its uniform 512 MiB limits are incomplete and unmeasured.
handoff.next_action: Inventory the NUC and measure the component and DJ-1 profiles before selecting service-specific limits.
known_limits: io-bci was absent from the old overlay
